name: Arlene Roberta Dickson

events.place: Christ Lutheran Christian Cemetery, Waldersee, Manitoba, Canada

notes: Arlene's parents were Arlie and May Dickson.  She had a brother Terry Dickson of Liefer and sisters Pat (husband Wally, of Winona, USA) and Doreen (husband John of Thunder Bay) and Kathy (husband Siggi of Liefer).
